market_summary: FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) are executing high-volume structural breakdowns below Value Area Low with heavy RVOL spikes and strongly aligned bearish CVD during the London session. US100 maintains a steady bullish trend well above VWAP and EMA50 near session highs. XAUUSD and BTCUSD are testing session high resistance levels but lack volume expansion and CVD alignment, warranting a HOLD.

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (4055.48) and above POC (4044.58), holding above VWAP (4047.79) and EMA50 (4050.38) during LONDON_SESSION. However, the last candle was rejected directly off the Session High (4066.79) resistance with neutral volume (rvol 0.879) and NEUTRAL CVD (+0.12, slope -0.5), while price trades mid-channel below the +2 ATR band (4066.0). Awaiting clear breakout or pullback setup.

Price broke out below VAL (1.11567) and POC (1.11652) during LONDON_SESSION, trading well below VWAP (1.1161) and EMA50 (1.11644). The breakdown is strongly confirmed by yellow RVOL > 2.0 (rvol 2.002) and strongly aligned BEARISH CVD (-6,436, slope -5,276.5). Price is pushing into the -2 ATR lower band (1.11494) as volatility expands, confirming momentum breakdown.
signals.level_event: acceptance below VAL and break of Session Low

signals.rationale: Strong breakdown below VAL (1.33365) and POC (1.33478) in LONDON_SESSION, well below VWAP (1.33425) and EMA50 (1.33474). Volatility is expanding with price probing beyond the -2 ATR lower band (1.33283) toward Prev Low (1.33119).
signals.level_event: acceptance below VAL and test of Session Low

signals.rationale: Strong steady trend in LONDON_SESSION holding comfortably above VWAP (28038.86) and EMA50 (27989.73), trading above POC (28113.83) and probing VAH / Session High (28187.63). CVD is BULLISH (+6.60) with positive slope (+1.37). While RVOL is 1.206 (grey bar), US100 CFD tick volume rarely spikes above 2.0; strong price structure and baseline alignment support continued upside momentum toward lower upper channel expansion.

Price is above VAH (73808.59), POC (73699.92), and VWAP (73616.71) in LONDON_SESSION, but showing heavy divergence with a BEARISH CVD (-0.03) and extremely low volume (rvol 0.45). The candle just wick-rejected the Session High (74085.2) and is sitting stretched near the upper +2 ATR band (74150.55) without volume/CVD confirmation. Prefer HOLD.
